chars.NARRATOR: a skinny young Moroccan man about 26, short black hair, light stubble, wearing a faded olive-green bomber jacket over a plain white t-shirt
chars.SHOPKEEPER: a chubby middle-aged Moroccan shopkeeper with a grey moustache, wearing a beige djellaba and a white knitted cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. NARRATOR sitting on a thin mattress in his small bare room with cracked walls, counting a small stack of Moroccan banknotes in his hands, serious determined face. Medium shot, face visible, centered.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. NARRATOR walking tired through a dusty sunny street of a small Moroccan town (Sidi Kacem) with low houses and small shops, looking left and right, searching, wiping sweat. Full figure centered, calm edges.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. At the counter of a small Moroccan corner shop, NARRATOR asks a question politely while SHOPKEEPER leans back and stares at him with a suspicious 'are you crazy?' look, one eyebrow raised. Both faces visible, medium shot, centered.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. NARRATOR standing relieved in front of the entrance of an old modest Moroccan building with a small blank brass plaque by the door (no letters), at the bottom of narrow stairs. Full figure centered.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical, light comic tone. NARRATOR frozen in the doorway of a crowded small waiting room, eyes wide and mouth open in surprise; inside, quirky cartoon patients: one man standing stiffly refusing to sit, one man glaring sideways at him, one man giggling to himself. Narrator's face clearly visible in the foreground, centered.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. NARRATOR sitting nervously on a wooden bench in a small waiting room among other waiting people, holding a small paper ticket, knee bouncing, glancing at a closed white door. Medium shot, face visible, centered.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. In a small waiting room, a patient walks out of a white door looking strangely serene and calm with a soft relaxed smile, while NARRATOR on the bench watches him, puzzled. Both faces visible, medium shot, centered.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. NARRATOR standing at a closed white door, hand on the handle, swallowing nervously, about to go in, tense suspenseful mood. Medium shot from behind his shoulder, his face visible in profile, centered.
